analysis: The only changed lines in this PR are a comment edit in SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift at head lines ~4361-4363. It clarifies that SSDWriteBehind.consume charges the write-rate bucket per entry in array order only when the whole donation does not fit. No executable code, production source or crypto/policy constant changes. The supplied units (head lines 3039-4237) are unchanged surrounding test code, which I read for context. It exercises behavior relevant to T-041: whole-root maintenance and TTL, symlinked-root rejection, lookalike and temp-file ownership preservation, per-donation gating, write-queue bounds, DBK3 AAD canonical metadata (no raw windowBase, HMAC-committed position), HMAC-domain-separated sidecar tags, and corrupt-sidecar fail-closed unlink. These tests encode the existing mitigations (HMAC-keyed names, scope isolation, TTL, fail-closed on corruption) and none of them is weakened by this diff. The comment change adds no attack surface and invalidates no threat-model assumption. Remaining uncertainty: the production SSDWriteBehind.consume semantic ('whole donation fits' rule) is outside the supplied evidence, so the comment's accuracy against the source was not verified. It is a test comment only, so there is no security impact.
